source: Squier Mustang, drawn in the pickguard frame (X to the neck, Y to the bass side, Z = 0 on the body top, mm). Waist, cutaway, treble horn and the upper bouts traced from IMG_2407 as it is placed in cad-midiguitar.FCStd. The bass horn, the lower bouts and the tail are drawn to a Mustang's proportions: about 380 x 230 mm over the body. Scale 24 in (609.6 mm) from the saddles (X -8 in the photo) to the nut; the fretboard end at X 166 in the photo is fret 22 of that scale, which checks it. Nut 42 mm (Fender). Body 42 mm deep.
